newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures close mostly lower on thin market.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures close mostly lower on thin market.

text.p: UK wheat futures closed mostly lower on Monday on a thin market.
Traders said the market was in need of fresh news to give it some direction.
Closing wheat values were 0.35 to 0.80 stg down although Nov 1997 finished 0.15 stg up. Turnover was a light 111 lots.
Barley finished a thin session with November 1.40 stg up and January 0.15 stg higher after trading 19 lots.
Traders said the sharp rise November was technical owing to the position expiring at the end of the week.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures were neglected.
